title: The Obsidian Seal
note: Showcase sample: A rapid-fire walk-and-talk high-fantasy adventure in the rhythmic cadence of Aaron Sorkin.

blocks.x: INT. CITADEL OF SARKON - HIGH CORRIDOR - DAY
Heavy granite vaults. Torches gutter in wrought-iron sconces. Footsteps ring out against the cold flagstones at a relentless, metronomic cadence.

LORD CHANCELLOR VANE (40s, velvet doublet, silver signet) strides with purpose. MISTRESS ELENA (30s, Chief Arcanist, ink-stained cuffs, carrying three brass cylinder scrolls) matches him stride for stride.
APPRENTICE TOBIAS (20, disheveled robes, juggling wax tablets) jogs to stay within earshot.
Tell me about the western ward.
Fluctuating isn't a word I like before my second cup of chicory, Elena. Tides fluctuate. Crop yields fluctuate. Seven-hundred-ton kinetic wards guarding sixty thousand civilians do not fluctuate.
The harmonic decay along the third rune line is three-point-two percent per bell.
Which means by sunset tomorrow, a determined mountain goat could kick through the outer perimeter, let alone the Frost-Giant infantry currently bivouacked twenty leagues north.
Chancellor, the Grand Marshal’s courier arrived from the borderlands--
Tobias, if that parchment does not say twenty-four hundred reserve archers have manifested out of thin air, put it back in your sleeve.
Gods preserve me from cavalry requisitions. Elena, why is the ward decaying?
Because the Archmage insisted on buying second-grade star-sapphires from the Merchant League of Valen to balance the fourth-quarter treasury report.
The League gave us a fifteen percent rebate.
The League sold you powdered calcite with blue glaze on it, Vane!
INT. GRAND VAULT OF RUNES - CONTINUOUS
Double iron doors swing wide. A subterranean chamber thrums with low, resonant energy. In the center: a hexagonal black obelisk suspended above an abyss of blue light.
Four senior magisters kneel in a circle, sweat pouring into their collars as faint cracks spider across the obelisk’s mirrored surface.
That is the primary compression seal. If it snaps, the thaumaturgical back-draft turns this entire palace into an eighty-foot smoking crater.
Well, on the bright side, the League of Valen won't be able to collect on the oats.
I need three hundred ounces of unrefined sunstone, twenty consecrated chisels, and total jurisdictional authority over the High Temple's reliquary.
The High Priest will file a writ of heresy before your chisel touches the lock.
Then tell the High Priest to go stand on the western battlement and pray the Frost-Giants have taken a sudden theological interest in mercy.
EXT. BATTLEMENTS OF CARAS VAL - MOMENTS LATER
Gale-force wind howls off the jagged peaks. Snow whips across the parapets. Banners snap violently against the stone.
CAPTAIN OSGAR (50s, chainmail scarred by wyvern fire, squinting through a brass spyglass) doesn't look back as Vane and Elena step out into the freeze.
Did she tell you the wall is going to collapse?
She used the word fluctuating. Then she compared the wall to a mountain goat.
Vane takes the spyglass. Presses it to his eye.
THROUGH THE LENS: Beyond the frozen pines, five miles out in the tundra valley, three enormous shadows carve paths through the blizzard. Siege engines made of mammoths and dark iron.
